opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, Femke speaking. How can I help?
opening.comment: The agent gave the company name and her own first name in the first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.comment: The agent changed the order on the basis of only an order number and never confirmed the caller's full name or a postcode, so the verification step was skipped.

understanding.quote: Customer: Wait, no, I didn't want to cancel all of it. I just wanted to change the size to medium. That's what I meant.
understanding.comment: The agent ignored the caller's clarified request to change the size and cancelled the whole order anyway, so the actual issue was not captured.

resolution_accuracy.quote: The order hadn't been dispatched, so cancelling is free, and the €69.00 goes back to your card in 3 to 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The cancellation policy and refund timeline quoted are correct, although the order was cancelled against the caller's stated wish, which is a handling failure rather than a factual error.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: You said cancel. It's cancelled. You'll have to order the medium again yourself.
process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo step applied, but the agent dismissed the caller's correction instead of confirming the intended change, so the order handling was not compliant.

communication.quote: Customer: I'm a bit panicked about it.
communication.comment: The caller said they were panicked and the agent did not acknowledge this; the agent was curt and dismissive when the caller corrected the request.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get a cancellation email in a few minutes. Is there anything else?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step, asked if there was anything else, and closed politely.
